Review `mercer1909`: the substantive original memoir is J. Mercer (1909), 'Functions of positive and negative type, and their connection with the theory of integral equations,' Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society A 209, 415–446, DOI 10.1098/rsta.1909.0016. The current DOI 10.1098/rspa.1909.0075 and pages 69–70 describe a short Proceedings notice. The full original memoir was opened from a University of Southern California faculty-hosted scan of the Royal Society PDF at https://dornsife.usc.edu/sergey-lototsky/wp-content/uploads/sites/211/2023/11/Mercer-original-compressed_compressed.pdf; its introduction p. 415 states the expansion proved in Part IV.
